description: This file defines the DefaultContentManager class, which implements content management operations such as creating, retrieving, updating, publishing, unpublishing, importing, and versioning of ContentItem objects within the OrchardCore CMS framework. It coordinates handlers, sessions, and validation for content lifecycle management.

classes.name: DefaultContentManager
classes.description: Implements content management operations such as creation, retrieval, updating, versioning, publishing, importing, and deletion of ContentItem objects, coordinating handlers, sessions, and validation within OrchardCore.

methods.name: NewAsync
methods.description: Creates a new ContentItem of the specified content type, invoking handlers for activation and initialization.

methods.name: GetAsync
methods.description: Retrieves a ContentItem by ID with specified version options, loading and possibly creating new versions as needed.

methods.name: GetAllVersionsAsync
methods.description: Retrieves all versions of a ContentItem by its ID.

methods.name: GetVersionAsync
methods.description: Retrieves a specific version of a ContentItem by version ID.

methods.name: SaveDraftAsync
methods.description: Saves the current ContentItem as a draft, invoking handlers for draft saving.

methods.name: PublishAsync
methods.description: Publishes a ContentItem, invoking handlers and updating published state.

methods.name: UnpublishAsync
methods.description: Unpublishes a ContentItem, updating its published state and invoking handlers.

methods.name: BuildNewVersionAsync
methods.description: Creates a new version of an existing ContentItem, marking previous as not latest.

methods.name: BuildNewVersionsAsync
methods.description: Creates new versions for a collection of ContentItems, handling versioning logic.

methods.name: CreateAsync
methods.description: Creates a new ContentItem, optionally publishing it, and invokes creation handlers.

methods.name: CreateContentItemVersionAsync
methods.description: Creates a new version of a ContentItem, with optional eviction of previous versions.

methods.name: UpdateContentItemVersionAsync
methods.description: Updates an existing ContentItem version, handling version conflicts and eviction.

methods.name: ImportAsync
methods.description: Imports multiple ContentItems in batches, creating or updating versions as needed.

methods.name: UpdateAsync
methods.description: Updates an existing ContentItem and invokes updating handlers.

methods.name: ValidateAsync
methods.description: Validates a ContentItem through handlers, cancelling session on failure.

methods.name: RestoreAsync
methods.description: Restores a ContentItem to a previous state, creating a new draft and handling versions.

methods.name: PopulateAspectAsync
methods.description: Populates a specific aspect of a ContentItem via handlers.

methods.name: RemoveAsync
methods.description: Removes all active versions of a ContentItem, invoking handlers.

methods.name: DiscardDraftAsync
methods.description: Discards a draft version, restoring the latest published version if available.

methods.name: CloneAsync
methods.description: Creates a clone of a ContentItem as a new draft, invoking cloning handlers.
